sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
Heard Mr. Ramendra Gupta, the learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State.

This bail application has been filed by the applicant Nitin seeking his enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 528 of 2022, under Sections 498A/34, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Kanchala, District Shamli, during the pendency of trial.
At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. contends that the applicant is husband of the deceased.
As per the post mortem report of the deceased, the cause of death of deceased is asphyxia as a result of ante mortem strangulation.

Nitin vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169009312/
1
When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.

He,
however, submits that even though applicant is a named as well as charge sheeted accused, yet, he is liable to be enlarged on bail.

He submits that trial has already commenced and four prosecution witnesses namely P.W. 1 Chentan Panchal, first informant/brother of the deceased, P.W.2 Poonam,
mother of the deceased, P.W. 3 Devendra father of the deceased and P.W. 5 Ankit Panchal, brother of the deceased have already deposed before Court below, but they have not supported the prosecution story.
At this stage, the Court raised a pointed query as to whether charge under Section 302 IPC has been altered or not.
Learned counsel for applicant could not reply the same.

Considering the above and also the fact that the death of the deceased has occurred in her marital home, cause of the death of the deceased is asphyxia as a result of ante mortem strangulation and in view of the statements of P.W. 1, P.W. 2, P.W. 3 and P.W. 5, the charge will have to be altered under Section 302 IPC, no good ground exists to enlarge the applicant on bail.
As a result, present bail application fails and is liable to be rejected.

Order Date :- 11.8.2023 HSM  Nitin vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169009312/
